_README: The sampling draw for calibration labelling, and the segmenter freeze it is valid against. M1-8 records the freeze; M1-11 (W4) records the seed and the draw. The two belong in one file because a label is only meaningful as (step_id, segmenter version) -- step_id embeds the segmenter's ordinal, so a draw taken against a different freeze is a draw against different text.

segmenter_freeze.note: Breaking this freeze re-runs the draw below and re-labels every affected step (Hazard 1). analyzer/tests/test_segmenter.py::test_golden_steps_are_unchanged is what makes that a conscious act rather than a surprise.

draw.note: UNSET on purpose. The plan requires the seed committed BEFORE the first label is written, and the first 40 labels come from the random-90 part in seeded order. M1-11 sets it; a non-null value here with no labels behind it would be a claim that the draw had happened.
